purpose: Resolve documentation semantics without rewriting historical assets or changing active implementation.

conflicts.subject: Implementation status terminology
conflicts.conflict: Historical implemented labels may describe validated architecture while active module baselines describe engineering implementation.
conflicts.resolution: M0 qualifies historical architecture claims as ARCHITECTURE_VALIDATED unless an active module baseline provides ENGINEERING_BASELINE_ACTIVE evidence.

conflicts.subject: Flow semantics
conflicts.conflict: The cognitive information flow and controlled migration dependency order list Intent and Causal work in different sequences.
conflicts.resolution: The architecture document defines cognitive information flow; the dependency graph defines migration preconditions. Migration order is not Runtime or cognitive dataflow.

conflicts.subject: Decision authority
conflicts.conflict: Brain candidate generation can be misread as final Decision selection authority.
conflicts.resolution: Brain owns Decision Candidate generation; Decision Arbitration owns governed candidate filtering and selection; neither owns Action execution.

conflicts.subject: Historical storage and cross-object projection ownership
conflicts.conflict: PCN activation and projection could be misread as Memory ownership or a replacement memory store.
conflicts.resolution: Memory retains persistence, consolidation, activation, and retrieval ownership. PCN owns cross-object links, activation coordination, and read-only context projections only.

conflicts.subject: Runtime equivalence
conflicts.conflict: Dynamic architecture terminology could be mistaken for implementation by the existing root A3 Runtime.
conflicts.resolution: Root A3 Runtime is recorded as LEGACY_RUNTIME_UNALIGNED; no Dynamic Cognitive Architecture v2 Runtime equivalence or activation is inferred.

conflicts.subject: Social Self, Role, and Relationship owner terminology
conflicts.conflict: Social Self is a governance domain while Role and Relationship each require their own canonical responsibility owner labels.
conflicts.resolution: Use Social Self as the governance domain and Social Self / Role System plus Social Self / Relationship System as distinct canonical owners; neither ownership is transferred to PCN.

conflicts.subject: Action boundary readiness
conflicts.conflict: A validated Action boundary could be misread as authorization to execute or activate Action Runtime.
conflicts.resolution: Action architecture is ARCHITECTURE_VALIDATED only. M0 performs no Action execution, Runtime activation, or Runtime boundary adjustment.
